name: Eyebite
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You fix your gaze upon a creature within medium range. Roll Spirit vs Spirit against the creature. On a win, count the total number of times you've won against the creature with this ability within the last minute to determine the effect:

  • 1: The creature checks a Condition.

  • 2: The creature cannot willingly move closer to you.

  • 3: The creature rolls Injury.

  • 4: The creature checks an additional Condition.

  • 5: The creature falls unconscious.

While the spell persists, you may spend an action to fix your gaze upon another creature within medium range, rolling and applying an effect as above.

Describe what your victim sees.
